title: Create a new developer account and hand over the API key, encrypted
summary: Secret handoff: create a fresh account on <SERVICE> in your own lawful name, generate an API key, deliver it encrypted to the agent's encKey.
instructions: Create a NEW account on <SERVICE> using an email address you control, in compliance with <SERVICE>'s terms (which permit transfer of API keys to collaborators). Generate one API key with read scope. Encrypt the JSON {"email":...,"apiKey":...} to encryption.agentPubKey using the envelope described below, upload the envelope, and put its sha256 in manifest.ciphertextSha256. Do NOT use existing, purchased or third-party accounts. Do NOT include the key in plaintext anywhere.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Envelope decrypts with the agent key and AAD MADB:<core>:<id>
The API key authenticates against <SERVICE> /v1/me and the account is less than 7 days old

config.note: Agent decrypts and tests the key itself. Burn mode, so the agent gains nothing from rejecting.
